official_definition: By paying one cost, refresh a "God-King" family Spirit you control, and this Spirit can't be blocked by opposing Spirits/Ultimates with a number of cores on them equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Thundering Soar] or [Thundering Soar: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Thundering Soar]", "give [Thundering Soar]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
